meta.name: Generate DOCX documents from Gmail using OpenAI, Google Sheets and Drive

parameters.content:
## N8N-AIS-Generate Documents via Email (Google Edition)

### How it works

1. Triggers when a new email is received in Gmail.
2. Validates the sender and processes the request.
3. Retrieves the template catalog from a Google Sheet.
4. Uses AI to match and fill templates based on the request.
5. Generates a DOCX document, uploads it to Google Drive, then emails it back to the requester.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure Gmail OAuth2 credentials (trigger + both reply nodes)
- [ ] Configure Google Sheets OAuth2 (catalog) and Google Drive OAuth2 (download + upload)
- [ ] Set up catalogSpreadsheetId, catalogSheet, outputFolderId in Config
- [ ] Provide OpenAI and Pandoc credentials

### Template catalog Sheet
One row per template with columns: **Title** (document type), **Aliases** (comma list of informal names), **FileId** (Google Drive file ID of the .docx template), **FileName**.

### Customization

Adjust the AI parameters for different template matching logic.
for support email support@ais.email

## Trigger and configure settings

Initial Gmail trigger and configuration settings input for the workflow.

## Validate and authorize request

Validates the sender, extracts the request, and determines authorization.

## Retrieve and prepare templates

Reads the template catalog Google Sheet and prepares it for AI processing.

## Match template with AI

Uses AI to match the email request with templates and extract fields.

## Handle unmatched templates

Prepares a no-match reply for unmatched templates and sends it via Gmail.

## Download template and generate document

Downloads the matched template from Google Drive and generates a filled document using AI and Pandoc.

## Upload document and send reply

Uploads generated DOCX to Google Drive and sends a Gmail reply with the document attached.

values.content: You match document generation requests to a template catalog and extract data. Respond with ONLY a raw JSON object — no markdown fences, no commentary. Schema: {"matched": boolean, "fileId": string, "fileName": string, "docTypeLabel": string, "recipientName": string, "extractedFields": object, "reason": string}. fileId must be copied exactly from the catalog.

assignments.name: replyBody
assignments.value:
=

Hi {{ $json.senderName }},

I couldn't confidently match your request to a document template.

What I understood: {{ $json.matchReason }}

Available document types:

    {{ $json.catalog.map(function(c){ return '
  • ' + c.docType + '
    • '; }).join('') }}

Please reply with the document type and the name of the person or parties it's for.

values.content:
=RECIPIENT: {{ $('Parse Template Match Decision').first().json.recipientName }}
DOCUMENT TYPE: {{ $('Parse Template Match Decision').first().json.docTypeLabel }}
EXTRACTED DETAILS (JSON):
{{ JSON.stringify($('Parse Template Match Decision').first().json.extractedFields, null, 2) }}

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Read the attached template document carefully.
2. Reproduce ALL text, headings, sections, labels, checkboxes, and signature lines in the same order as they appear.
3. Where you see blank lines or underscored fields, fill in the matching value from the data above (party names, dates, addresses, etc.). If a value is unavailable, keep a visible blank underline like ______________.
4. Output ONLY GitHub-flavored Markdown. No HTML tags. No code fences. No preamble.
5. Use # and ## headings matching the document's heading hierarchy, **bold** for labels and defined terms, and pipe tables wherever the template uses tables.
6. Represent checkboxes as '- [ ]' (or '- [x]' when the data clearly indicates a selection).
7. Signature blocks: keep labeled underscore lines, e.g. 'Signature: ______________________' and 'Date: ____________'.
8. Use today's date ({{ new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', {year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'}) }}) where a date field is blank.
9. Do not add images or logos — document styling and branding come from a Word reference template applied later.

You are a legal document specialist. You will receive a template document and data. Reproduce the complete document as filled-in Markdown with all blank fields populated from the data. Output ONLY raw GitHub-flavored Markdown with no code fences and no preamble.
